verdict.rationale: three.js ships numbered releases (npm 0.186.0) with release notes. It also maintains an official Migration Guide wiki with per-version sections such as 185→186, so API changes between versions are documented. missing for 10: an explicit written deprecation policy (timelines, warning periods, semver guarantees), evidence of deprecation warnings or stability commitments, and independent corroboration of upgrade reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
